colors.mode: Dark Sci-Fi by Default with Light Mode Switch

key_components: Top Navigation with Campus/Year Selector, Dark/Light Toggle & Notifications
Collapsible Sci-Fi Sidebar with Glowing Active Indicators
Command Center Dashboard (Active KPI grid, Recharts charts, Telemetry Feed)
Student & Guardian CRUD with Modal and Data Tables
Cash Register Control (Apertura/Cierre de Caja) with Payment Receipts
Unified Multi-format Export Center (PDF, Excel, CSV, JSON, Word, Print)

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, export options, table headers, rows, and key KPI values MUST have a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI uses Spanish text throughout.
Default to dark mode with smooth transition when toggled to light mode.
Support all 6 export actions (PDF, XLSX, CSV, JSON, DOCX, Print) with downloadable mock/real binary generation or file trigger.
Use mock local state with initial seed data containing complete students, guardians, invoices, cash sessions, and audit logs.
Ensure login page clearly pre-fills or presents the Admin credentials: admin@jarvisschool.edu / AdminERP2026!.
